keyFindings.description: The LEGION-52 parenthetical presents the 2026-09-13 incident as the pane-contract skew the gate catches and quotes `LEGION_GRANT is missing`. The incident was a pre-LEGION-54 daemon (no LEGION_GRANT_FILE) with plugin 1.17.1 whose env delivery the secretsd shim dropped: both sides at the same pane contract, so the number would not have refused it. A real skew prints grantFrom's `LEGION_GRANT_FILE names <path>, which could not be read ... the installed plugin predates LEGION-54` (cli/index.ts:122-139, index.test.ts:52-66). Drop the parenthetical or state the current message.

'refuses ... any release through 1.22.2 ... instead of spawning workers that fail because a pre-credential-file plugin never wrote the file' is false for 1.20.0-1.22.2: LEGION-54 builds (#992 in 1.20.0, released 06:06Z) that write the file, refused only for declaring 1 after LEGION-20. Also releases without the field print `contract none`, not `contract 1` (boot-probes.ts:271-274).

'every environment variable ...' enumeration (same in all five texts) omits LEGION_CONTROL_SUBJECT (root panes; processes.ts:2487, legion.ts:316) and ENVOY_NATS_URL/ENVOY_URL (processes.ts:2485-2486, envoy-client defaults.ts:27-34). Add them or say 'including'.
Identity variables scoped to what classify.ts reads; daemon AGENTS.md enumerates LEGION_WORKSPACE/LEGION_STATE_DIR, read in extensions/legion.ts:407,478,510. Align the two.
